02. The Assistant Commissioner (Revenue)/Collector Land Acquisition, Rajouri vide his Communication no. AC/LA/188-89 dated 28.09.1999 came to submit a reference titled - "Collector Land Acquisition (Assistant Commissioner), Rajouri vs Abdul Shakoor and Ors." to the Principal District Judge, Rajouri with regard to Award no. AC/LA/252-53 dated 11.09.1996 in terms whereof compensation @25,000/- per kanal for land measuring 25 kanals and 5 marlas situated in village Thandi Kassi tehsil Rajouri had been granted.

sentences.text: The said reference came to be decided by the Principal District Judge, Rajouri.
In 03.

sentences.text: The reference made by the Assistant Commissioner (Collector Land Acquisition), Rajouri comprised of 62 leaves.

04. The Additional District Judge, Rajouri came to dispose of the said reference on its File no.
11/ADJ titled - "Abdul Shakoor and Ors. vs Collector Land Acquisition (Assistant Commissioner Revenue), Rajouri"
bearing date of institution 30.09.1999 and 11.08.2009 vide its judgment dated 22.08.2009.
05.

entities.text: Abdul Shakoor and Ors. vs Collector Land Acquisition (Assistant Commissioner Revenue), Rajouri
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Against the said judgment, there has come to be filed two miscellaneous appeals, an appeal CIMA no. 444/2009 is by the aggrieved land owners, namely, Abdul Shakoor, Mohd. Sharief and Fateh Mohd acting through their attorney holder Mohd. Bashir Khan.

This appeal is under section 52 of the Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 registering the grievance that the Additional District Judge, Rajouri in its judgment dated 22.08.2009 has assessed the compensation payable for the land @35,000/- per kanal as against the Collector's assessed compensation of an amount of 25,000/- per kanal.
In their memo of appeal, the appellants in CIMA no. 444/2009 have claimed that compensation ought to have been assessed @60,000/- per kanal.
In 06. A perusal of this file in the course of judgment making, led this Court to come across with two aspects.

Firstly, the complete record of the reference made by the Assistant Commissioner, Revenue (Collector Land Acquisition), Rajouri is not obtaining on the record of this case whereas the only record which has come from the court of the Additional District Judge, Rajouri is of its File no.
3/L.A.Act of 30.09.1999 whereas the reference record of 62 leaves is not obtaining on the file.
There is a requirement for summoning of the said record of reference in its complete form.

07. Secondly, the matter in reference proceedings before the Additional District Judge, Rajouri was conducted by the appellant, namely, Abdul Shakoor, Mohd. Sharief and Fateh Mohd through its attorney Mohd. Bashir Khan S/o Abdullah R/o Suranoo, tehsil and district Rajouri who was holding a registered deed of special power of attorney registered by the Sub-Registrar, Rajouri on 13.09.1995.
08.
During the course of long pendency of this matter, whether the principals i.e. the appellants or/and their attorney, namely, Mohd. Bashir Khan are/is alive or not needs to be confirmed.
Accordingly, on these two aspects, the judgment in the case needs to be deferred.

09. Since, against the very said judgment dated 22.08.2009 of the Additional District Judge,
Rajouri

, the Collector Land Acquisition has also In come forward with appeal CIA no. 03 of 2010 in which the respondents, namely, Abdul Shakoor, Mohd. Sharief and Fateh Mohd., have caused their appearance through power of attorney dated 15.03.2010 filed on their behalf by their said attorney,
namely, Mohd. Bashir Khan.

Said original attorney holder Mohd. Bashir Khan expired which resulted in purported execution of a fresh special power of attorney by the respondents, namely,
